title: Scaling Attention Beyond GPUs for LLM Inference
selection_reason: Beyond is a drop-in hybrid CPU-GPU attention runtime for oversized KV caches, combining selective KV retention, CPU-resident sparse attention, and minimal PCIe movement; this is a direct fit for offload and hierarchical-memory inference.
